variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by {company}.
variants.body:
The company {company} has laid off many workers. The scale is described as large, but a specific number is not supplied here. In assessing {target}, readers should distinguish the loss of jobs from an invented cause, severance arrangement or account of what will happen to those affected.

The gazette records the large layoff without assigning a count or a reason not supplied in the report. A reduction in employment and the failure of a company are distinct events. The account should not imply that the business has closed, or that a particular assistance arrangement has been established.

We hold {target} to account critically. A large loss of jobs is not a minor adjustment in the lives of workers, and its stewardship deserves a more demanding standard than a convenient abstraction. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.sub: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff.
variants.body:

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.sub: The company {company} has laid off many workers.
variants.body:
